title: jambosa alba
intro: Jambosa alba, commonly known as White Malabar Plum, is a plant species belonging to the family Salicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. Jambosa alba has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, fever, and skin infections, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Jambosa alba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
